summary: Adlai Nortye Group Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 30, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting held in Singapore. Holders of 40,433,365 ordinary shares, out of 193,193,810 issued and outstanding as of the August 28, 2026 record date, were present in person or by proxy, constituting a quorum. All resolutions, whose full text was included in the August 26, 2026 EGM notice previously furnished, were duly passed. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; this is a routine meeting-results filing.
